standard-dialogue-before-shilo-village.npc: We used to run cart trips down to Shilo Village in south Karamja. Since the troubles we had we've had to stop them though, too many people got killed.

standard-dialogue-after-shilo-village-if.npc: I am offering a cart ride to Shilo Village, if you're interested. It will cost [amount] coins. Is that okay?

options.text: Yes please, I'd like to go to Shilo Village.

steps.player: Yes please, I'd like to go to Shilo Village.

steps.text: If the player has enough coins:
You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Shilo Village.
The player is transported to Shilo Village
